sum_{k=1}^{89} sin(2° * k) = [sin(89 * 2° / 2) * sin((89 + 1) * 2° / 2)] / sin(2° / 2)

Compute that:

First, compute the numerator:

sin(89 * 2° / 2) = sin(89°)

sin((89 + 1) * 2° / 2) = sin(90°)

Denominator: sin(2° / 2) = sin(1°)

Therefore, the sum is [sin(89°) * sin(90°)] / sin(1°) = [sin(89°) * 1] / sin(1°) = sin(89°)/sin(1°)

But sin(89°) = cos(1°), so this is cos(1°)/sin(1°) = cot(1°).
